bibliographic.title: Low-power soil moisture sensor network with exception reporting

publication.abstract: A buried soil moisture sensor transmits a reading over a low-power radio only when the moisture value has changed by more than a set amount since the last transmitted reading, and otherwise transmits a heartbeat message once per day. The sensor also detects a wetting event when its reading rises by more than a threshold within a time window, and then samples more often until the reading settles.

claims.claim: A soil sensor that transmits a moisture reading only when it differs from the last transmitted reading by more than a threshold, and transmits a heartbeat at least once per day.
The sensor of claim 1, which detects a wetting event from a rise of the reading by more than a set fraction within a time window.
